meta.title: feat: Add support for multiple tool calls in a single message
meta.body_summary: Add support for executing multiple tool calls within a single message to reduce round-trips and improve agent workflow efficiency.

perf_labels.notes: Claude_Code added multi-tool parsing and execution with narrative perf claims; no maintainer review or engagement over ~360 days; PR closed without merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 646 changed lines across 4 files, this is a medium‑sized feature addition by absolute volume, dominated by a comprehensive test file (466 lines). As a performance‑oriented feature PR, it was closed without merge due to lack of maintainer activity over a year, consistent with a stale, unreviewed contribution.

review_details.concern_detail: No human or formal review was provided; only a CLA‑signature bot comment. The PR remained open for a year before being closed without merge.
review_details.performance_claim: Executing multiple tool calls in a single message reduces round‑trips and improves agent workflow efficiency, with no performance degradation for 15+ concurrent calls (narrative claim).
review_details.rejection_signals: PR left unreviewed for ~360 days; closed by inactivity. No explicit rejection; likely stale orphaned contribution.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: The agent produced a feature with tests and narrative performance claims, but the PR never received maintainer attention in a small repository. This illustrates a process boundary where agent‑generated PRs may stall without community review or maintainer pull‑in.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body describes performance gains in prose but provides no benchmark data, profiling, or reproducible measurement steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed after ~360 days with no fix cycle; no regressions discussed.

core_change_summary.description: Added XMLParser.parse_all() using re.findall to extract multiple <tool> tags; updated ToolEnv.env_response() to execute tools sequentially, collecting results with tool name labels; added extensive tests.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Test files comprise the bulk of the diff (466 changes), covering multiple tool scenarios, error handling, and backward compatibility.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added parse_all() to XMLParser and multi‑tool execution in tool_env with 'Tool N result:' prefix.
Second commit: Refactored result labels to use actual tool names (e.g., 'add_tool result:').
Third commit: Added trailing newlines to test files.

Only CLA bot comment acknowledged CLA signing.
No human interaction or review occurred; PR closed after ~360 days.
